```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cross-account role for SSM Patch Manager access

Resources:
  PatchCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SSM-Patch-CrossAccount-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/PatchingAdmin
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: true
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMPatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'

  PatchAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      AssociationName: SAP-Patch-Baseline-Apply
      Targets:
        - Key: tag:Environment
          Values: [Prod, Shared, DR]
      TaskArn: AWS-RunPatchBaseline
      TaskType: COMMAND
      Parameters:
        Operation: [Install]
        PatchGroups: [SAP-Kernel-Patches]
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical, low-risk patch management for SAP on AWS with governance and rollback.

## Key Concepts

- AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager
- Patch Baselines and Maintenance Windows
- IAM roles for SSM
- CloudFormation automation

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPPatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPPatchAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:ListCommands
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                Resource: '*'
  SAPOSPatchBaseline:
    Type: AWS::SSM::PatchBaseline
    Properties:
      Name: SAP-OS-PatchBaseline
      OperatingSystem: 'AMAZON_LINUX_2'
      ApprovalRules:
        PatchRules:
          - PatchFilterGroup:
              PatchFilters:
                - Key: 'CLASSIFICATION'
                  Values:
                    - 'Security'
                    - 'Critical'
            ComplianceLevel: 'CRITICAL'
            ApproveAfterDays: 0
```

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  DRExecutorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - states.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DRExecutorPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:*
                  - route53:*
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - s3:*
                Resource: '*'
  DRStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt DRExecutorRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: >
        {
          "Comment": "DR workflow",
          "StartAt": "CheckHealth",
          "States": {
            "CheckHealth": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:::function:CheckHealth",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to architect serverless SAP batch orchestration, cross-account security, idempotency, and auditability.

## Key Concepts
- Step Functions, Lambda
- SAP RFC batch submission, ABAP jobs
- Idempotency, retries, compensation
- STS cross-account credentials
- Centralized auditing

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPBatchLauncherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBatchExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: arn:aws:iam::*:role/SAPOperatorRole
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  SAPBatchStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      DefinitionString:
        !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "SAP Batch Job Orchestration",
          "StartAt": "ValidateInput",
          "States": {
            "ValidateInput": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:validate-batch-input",
              "Next": "CheckIdempotency",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.Unknown", "Lambda.ServiceException"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                "MaxAttempts": 3,
                "BackoffRate": 2.0
              }]
            },
            "CheckIdempotency": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:check-dedupe",
              "Next": "SubmitABAPJob",
              "Catch": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["DuplicateJob"],
                "Next": "SkipExecution"
              }]
            },
            "SubmitABAPJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:submit-abap-batch",
              "Next": "MonitorJob",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["SAPConnectionError", "RFCError"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                "MaxAttempts": 5,
                "BackoffRate": 2.0
              }, {
                "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 10,
                "MaxAttempts": 2,
                "BackoffRate": 1.5
              }],
              "Catch": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                "Next": "CancelJob",
                "ResultPath": "$.error"
              }]
            },
            "MonitorJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:monitor-abap-status",
              "Next": "LogCompletion",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["JobInProgress"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 30,
                "MaxAttempts": 20,
                "BackoffRate": 1.2
              }]
            },
            "CancelJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:cancel-abap-batch",
              "Next": "LogFailure",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["CancelError"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                "MaxAttempts": 3,
                "BackoffRate": 1.5
              }]
            },
            "LogCompletion": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-log",
              "End": true
            },
            "LogFailure": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-log",
              "End": true
            },
            "SkipExecution": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-duplicate",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SAPBatchLauncherRole.Arn
```
